items.prompt: Write a complete 4-sentence informative paragraph about the life cycle of a frog. Include an introduction, two facts or stages, and a concluding sentence.
items.answer: Sample: The life cycle of a frog has four stages. First, a frog begins as an egg laid in water, then hatches into a tadpole with a tail and no legs. Over time, the tadpole grows legs and loses its tail, eventually becoming a full-grown frog. The frog life cycle is a remarkable example of how animals can completely change their form as they grow.

items.prompt:
Read this informative paragraph. Identify the introduction sentence, two fact sentences, and the concluding sentence.

'The Grand Canyon is one of the most famous natural landmarks in the United States. It is located in Arizona and stretches for 277 miles. The canyon was carved over millions of years by the Colorado River. Today, millions of visitors travel to the Grand Canyon each year to see its breathtaking views.'
items.answer: Introduction: 'The Grand Canyon is one of the most famous natural landmarks in the United States.' Facts: 'It is located in Arizona and stretches for 277 miles' and 'The canyon was carved over millions of years by the Colorado River.' Concluding sentence: 'Today, millions of visitors travel to the Grand Canyon each year to see its breathtaking views.'

steps: The introduction names the topic. The two fact sentences give specific information. The concluding sentence wraps up.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph (4 sentences) about deserts. Include: an introduction sentence, a definition of what a desert is, one fact about desert animals, and a concluding sentence.
items.answer: Sample: A desert is a dry region that receives very little rainfall throughout the year. Because deserts get less than 10 inches of rain per year, few plants and animals can survive there. However, some animals, like camels and lizards, have adapted to desert life by storing water or being active only at night. Deserts are fascinating places that remind us how life can find a way even in the harshest conditions.

items.prompt: A student wrote: 'The brain is a really important organ. I think learning about the brain is interesting. The brain controls everything you do.' Fix the paragraph by replacing the opinion sentence with a factual one.
items.answer: Improved: 'The brain is a really important organ. It is the control center of the body, sending signals to every muscle and organ to keep you alive and moving. The brain controls everything you do.'

steps: Remove 'I think learning about the brain is interesting' — it is an opinion.
Replace it with a fact: describe what the brain does as the body's control center.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about the solar system. Include an introduction sentence, two facts, and a concluding sentence. Do not use any opinion language.
items.answer: Sample: The solar system is made up of the sun and all the objects that orbit around it. There are eight planets in our solar system, including Earth, Mars, and Jupiter. The sun is a star at the center of the solar system, and its gravity holds all the planets in their orbits. The solar system is so vast that it would take thousands of years to travel from one end to the other.

steps: Fact 2: what the sun is and does.

items.prompt: Write an introduction sentence and three fact sentences for an informative paragraph about the ocean. Save the concluding sentence for last.
items.answer: Sample: The ocean is a vast body of salt water that covers about 71 percent of Earth's surface. The ocean is divided into five major sections: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic Oceans. It is home to thousands of species of fish, mammals, and other sea creatures. The ocean also plays a key role in regulating Earth's climate by storing heat from the sun.

steps: Introduction: name and describe the ocean.

items.prompt:
Rewrite this weak informative paragraph to make it stronger by adding a definition and a specific fact.

'Fire trucks are big and red. They go to fires. Firefighters use them.'
items.answer: Improved: 'A fire truck is a large vehicle specially designed to carry firefighters and equipment to the scene of a fire. Fire trucks are equipped with hoses, ladders, and hundreds of gallons of water to help fight fires. Firefighters use them to rescue people and put out dangerous fires in homes, buildings, and forests.'

steps: Replace the vague first sentence with a definition.
Replace the second sentence with a specific fact about equipment.
Improve the third sentence with more detail.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about electricity. Include an introduction, a definition of what electricity is, a fact about how we use it, and a concluding sentence.
items.answer: Sample: Electricity is a form of energy caused by the movement of tiny particles called electrons. It is one of the most useful forms of energy because it can power lights, computers, televisions, and many other machines. Electricity can be made from many sources, including wind, solar power, and burning fuels. Without electricity, most of the technology that people rely on every day would not work.

items.prompt:
Choose the BEST concluding sentence for an informative paragraph about healthy eating:
A) I love eating fruits and vegetables.
B) Healthy eating can be hard.
C) Eating a variety of healthy foods gives your body the nutrients it needs to grow, think, and stay strong.
D) That is why I eat vegetables every day.

steps: A concluding sentence for informative writing wraps up with a factual summary or statement of importance. C does this without using personal opinion language.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph (4 sentences) about why exercise is important for the body. Use facts and definitions only.
items.answer: Sample: Exercise is any physical activity that makes the body work harder than usual. Regular exercise strengthens muscles, improves heart health, and helps the body stay at a healthy weight. Exercise also helps the brain work better by increasing blood flow and releasing chemicals that improve mood and focus. Getting at least 60 minutes of physical activity each day is recommended for children to stay healthy.

items.prompt: Write the introduction sentence AND concluding sentence for this informative paragraph. The middle facts are: 'Ancient Egyptians built pyramids as tombs for their pharaohs. The Great Pyramid of Giza is one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World and is more than 4,500 years old.'
items.answer: Introduction: The ancient Egyptians were one of the most advanced civilizations in history. Concluding sentence: The pyramids stand today as an enduring symbol of the power and skill of the ancient Egyptians.

steps: Introduction: introduce the Egyptians or their pyramids as the topic.
Concluding sentence: wrap up by stating the lasting importance of the pyramids.

items.prompt:
Identify whether each sentence is an introduction, a fact, or a concluding sentence:
A) The human heart is an amazing organ.
B) The heart beats about 100,000 times every single day.
C) Blood carries oxygen from the heart to every part of the body.
D) The heart is essential to keeping every part of the body alive and healthy.
items.answer: A = Introduction. B = Fact. C = Fact. D = Concluding sentence.

steps: Introduction: first sentence that names the topic.
Facts: sentences that give specific true information.
Concluding sentence: last sentence that wraps up the topic.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about how seeds grow into plants. Include the steps in order.
items.answer: Sample: A seed contains everything needed to grow a new plant. When a seed is planted in soil and given water, it begins to sprout a tiny root and a small green shoot. The shoot pushes up through the soil toward the sunlight and slowly grows into a seedling with leaves. Over time, the seedling becomes a full-grown plant that can make flowers, fruits, and new seeds of its own.

steps: Step 1: sprouting in soil with water.
Concluding sentence: final stage of growth.

items.prompt:
Compare these two informative paragraphs. Explain which is stronger and why.

Paragraph A: 'Bats are cool animals. They fly at night. Some bats eat bugs. I like bats.'
Paragraph B: 'Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly. Most bats are nocturnal, meaning they are active at night and sleep during the day. Many bats eat thousands of insects each night, making them important helpers for farmers and gardeners. Bats play a vital role in controlling insect populations around the world.'
items.answer: Paragraph B is stronger. It has a clear introduction with a definition, specific facts with details, and a strong concluding sentence. Paragraph A mixes in a personal opinion ('I like bats'), uses vague language ('cool animals'), and has no concluding sentence.

steps: Check each paragraph for: factual introduction, specific facts/definitions, no opinions, and a concluding sentence.
Paragraph B meets all these criteria; Paragraph A does not.

items.prompt: Write a complete informative paragraph (4-5 sentences) about a community helper of your choice (example: firefighter, doctor, librarian, teacher). Include an introduction, two or three facts about their job, and a concluding sentence.
items.answer: Sample: Librarians are community helpers who manage libraries and help people find information and books. A librarian organizes thousands of books so they are easy to find and helps visitors search for information on computers. They also read stories to children, teach research skills, and make sure the library is a welcoming place for everyone. Librarians play an important role in helping their community learn and grow.

steps: Introduction: name and describe the community helper.
Fact 1: a specific task they do.
Concluding sentence: state their importance to the community.
